title: [GMCP 203.042.02] Production path: Performance, capacity, fairness, and resource budgets
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-042-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Published latency, throughput, startup, memory, descriptor, CPU, disk and event-fanout budgets are enforced per server, tenant and gateway under representative and adversarial load. Admission control, backpressure and fair scheduling prevent noisy neighbors; benchmarks are reproducible across supported platforms; regression thresholds gate release; and overload degrades explicitly without deadlock or unbounded growth. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
